en: next to or very near something
simple: The shop is adjacent to the bank.
toeic: Our office is adjacent to the main train station.
toeic_zh: 我們的辦公室緊鄰火車總站。

zh: 顧問的；諮詢的；警告性的
en: giving advice or an official warning
simple: There is a weather advisory today.
toeic: The travel advisory warns of heavy rain this weekend.
toeic_zh: 旅遊警示指出本週末將有大雨。

en: more than enough
simple: There is ample room in the car.
toeic: The hall provides ample parking for all visitors.
toeic_zh: 大廳為所有訪客提供充足的停車位。

en: a curved line or shape
simple: The rainbow made a big arc.
toeic: The building's entrance is designed as a wide arc of glass.
toeic_zh: 這棟大樓的入口被設計成一個寬廣的玻璃弧形。

en: a person who designs buildings
simple: The architect drew a new house.
simple_zh: 建築師畫了一棟新房子。
toeic: The architect presented three design options for the company headquarters.
toeic_zh: 建築師針對公司總部提出了三種設計方案。

en: relating to the design of buildings
simple: It has a nice architectural style.
toeic: The firm won an award for its architectural design.
toeic_zh: 這家公司因其建築設計而獲獎。

en: a large hall where people watch talks or shows
simple: The show is in the auditorium.
toeic: The auditorium can seat up to five hundred guests for the product launch.
toeic_zh: 這座禮堂可容納多達五百位賓客參加產品發表會。

en: very small living things that can cause disease
simple: Soap kills bacteria on your hands.
simple_zh: 肥皂能殺死手上的細菌。
toeic: Chefs must wash their hands to prevent the spread of bacteria.
toeic_zh: 廚師必須洗手以防止細菌傳播。

en: a small platform on the outside wall of a building
toeic: Each suite in the new hotel has a private balcony with a sea view.
toeic_zh: 新飯店的每間套房都有可看海景的私人陽台。

en: a story of a building that is largely or entirely below ground level
toeic: Basement waterproofing prevents moisture infiltration.
toeic_zh: 地下室防水防止了水分入侵。

en: a room with a bath, shower, or toilet
simple: The bathroom is on the left.
toeic: Each guest room includes a private bathroom with a shower.
toeic_zh: 每間客房都附有淋浴的獨立浴室。

en: A long seat for several people, often outdoors.
simple: We sat on a bench in the park.
simple_zh: 我們坐在公園的長椅上。
toeic: The city installed a new bench near the bus stop for commuters.
toeic_zh: 市政府在公車站旁新設了一張長椅供通勤者使用。

en: a detailed plan or design
simple: The architect showed us the blueprint of the building.
simple_zh: 建築師向我們展示了建築物的藍圖。
toeic: The blueprint outlined all structural specifications and safety requirements.
toeic_zh: 藍圖列出了所有結構規格和安全要求。

en: A piece of furniture with shelves for books.
simple: The bookcase is full of books.
toeic: Please place the manuals on the bookcase behind my desk.
toeic_zh: 請把手冊放在我辦公桌後面的書櫃上。

en: A tool with a long handle for sweeping floors.
toeic: The cleaner keeps a broom and a mop in the supply closet.
toeic_zh: 清潔人員把掃帚和拖把放在儲物櫃裡。

en: The glass part of a lamp that gives light.
simple: The bulb in my room is broken.
toeic: Please replace the bulb in the hallway as soon as possible.
toeic_zh: 請盡快更換走廊的燈泡。

en: a place in a workplace where people buy and eat meals
simple: We eat lunch in the cafeteria.
simple_zh: 我們在自助餐廳吃午餐。
toeic: The company will renovate the cafeteria to add more seating.
toeic_zh: 公司將翻修員工餐廳以增加座位。

en: a person who makes and repairs things made of wood
toeic: We hired a carpenter to build shelves in the new storage room.
toeic_zh: 我們僱了一位木工在新儲藏室裡做架子。

en: Great care taken to avoid danger or mistakes.
simple: Use caution on the wet floor.
toeic: Please proceed with caution when entering the construction zone.
toeic_zh: 進入施工區域時請小心前進。

en: the upper inner surface of a room
simple: The ceiling is ten feet high.
toeic: Dropped ceiling panels provide easy access to utilities and improve acoustics.
toeic_zh: 下垂的天花板面板提供了對公用設施的便捷訪問並改善了音效。

en: Rather cold, but not extremely cold.
toeic: The forecast says it will be chilly and windy tomorrow.
toeic_zh: 預報說明天會又冷又有風。

en: A person or product that cleans things.
toeic: The cleaner will wash the windows on the third floor today.
toeic_zh: 清潔人員今天會擦三樓的窗戶。

en: The state of being clean.
simple: Cleanliness is important in a kitchen.
toeic: Guests praised the cleanliness of the hotel rooms.
toeic_zh: 旅客稱讚飯店客房的整潔。

en: A small room or cupboard for storing things.
simple: My coat is in the closet.
toeic: Extra paper is kept in the supply closet.
toeic_zh: 備用紙張放在儲物櫃裡。

en: The act of shutting something permanently or for a time.
toeic: The closure of the factory will affect two hundred workers.
toeic_zh: 工廠關閉將影響兩百名員工。

en: Full of clouds, with little sun.
toeic: It will be cloudy with light rain this afternoon.
toeic_zh: 今天下午多雲並有小雨。

en: The state of being finished.
toeic: The completion of the new building is expected in June.
toeic_zh: 新大樓預計六月完工。

en: A device or product that improves the condition of something.
toeic: The air conditioner in the conference room is not working.
toeic_zh: 會議室的冷氣壞了。

en: An apartment in a building where each owner owns a unit.
toeic: The developer is building a new condominium near the station.
toeic_zh: 建商正在車站附近興建一棟新的公寓大樓。

en: voluntary agreement or compliance with something
simple: Consent from both parties is required.
toeic: Informed consent ensures stakeholder agreement with project plans.
toeic_zh: 知情同意確保利益相關者同意項目計劃。

en: a person or company hired to do specific work
simple: The contractor finished the job on time.
simple_zh: 承包商按時完成了工作。
toeic: We selected an experienced contractor with excellent project management skills.
toeic_zh: 我們選擇了一位具有優秀項目管理技能的經驗豐富的承包商。

en: in a way that is easy or useful
simple: The hotel is conveniently near the station.
simple_zh: 飯店離車站很近，很方便。
toeic: The office is conveniently located near the subway station.
toeic_zh: 辦公室位置便利，就在地鐵站附近。

en: a soft bag used to sit on or protect
simple: I sat on a soft cushion.
toeic: Extra cash gives the company a cushion against unexpected costs.
toeic_zh: 額外現金讓公司在面對意外開支時有緩衝。

en: to make a place look nicer
toeic: The staff will decorate the lobby for the annual celebration.
toeic_zh: 員工將為年度慶祝活動布置大廳。

en: something used to make a place look nice
toeic: The hotel lobby has festive decoration for the holiday season.
toeic_zh: 飯店大廳為節慶季節布置了喜慶的裝飾。

en: to destroy or tear down a building
simple: They will demolish the old building next month.
simple_zh: 他們下個月將拆除舊建築。
toeic: The company plans to demolish the obsolete warehouse and build a modern facility.
toeic_zh: 公司計劃拆除過時的倉庫並建造現代設施。

en: to become worse over time
toeic: Road conditions may deteriorate quickly if the snow continues.
toeic_zh: 如果持續下雪，路況可能迅速惡化。

en: to cause great damage or sadness
simple: The storm will devastate the town.
simple_zh: 暴風雨會摧毀這個城鎮。
toeic: The flood devastated several farms along the river last spring.
toeic_zh: 去年春天洪水摧毀了河岸沿線的幾座農場。

en: the act of getting rid of something
toeic: The company has a strict policy on the disposal of chemicals.
toeic_zh: 公司對化學品的處置有嚴格的規定。

en: to throw away or get rid of
simple: Dispose of trash in the bin.
toeic: Please dispose of used batteries at the designated collection point.
toeic_zh: 請將廢電池丟棄至指定回收點。

en: the amount of medicine taken at one time
toeic: Do not exceed the recommended dose printed on the label.
toeic_zh: 請勿超過標籤上標示的建議劑量。

en: on or to a lower floor
toeic: The cafeteria is located downstairs next to the main entrance.
toeic_zh: 自助餐廳位於樓下，就在大門旁邊。

en: the main business area of a city
toeic: Our new office will be located in downtown Chicago.
toeic_zh: 我們的新辦公室將位於芝加哥市中心。

en: a long period with very little rain
simple: The drought made the farm dry.
toeic: The severe drought has raised the price of vegetables.
toeic_zh: 嚴重乾旱使蔬菜價格上漲。

en: relating to electricity or electric systems
simple: The electrical system needs to be updated.
toeic: Electrical wiring throughout the facility must comply with safety standards.
toeic_zh: 整個設施的電氣佈線必須符合安全標準。

en: a person whose job is to fix electrical systems
toeic: We hired an electrician to rewire the old office.
toeic_zh: 我們請了一位電工替舊辦公室重新配線。

en: a platform or compartment that moves vertically between floors
simple: The elevator is out of order today.
toeic: The building is equipped with high-speed elevators for efficient vertical transportation.
toeic_zh: 建築物配備了高速電梯以實現高效的垂直運輸。

en: in a way that relates to the natural environment
simple_zh: 我們使用對環境安全的產品。
toeic: The factory is committed to being environmentally responsible.
toeic_zh: 這間工廠致力於對環境負責。

en: a moving staircase in a building
simple: Take the escalator to the second floor.
toeic: The escalator near the entrance is out of order today.
toeic_zh: 入口附近的電扶梯今天故障。

en: to leave a dangerous place quickly
simple_zh: 所有人都必須撤離大樓。
toeic: Staff were told to evacuate the building during the fire alarm.
toeic_zh: 火災警報響起時，員工被要求撤離大樓。

en: a way out of a building or place
simple: The exit is on the left.
toeic: Please use the nearest exit in case of a fire.
toeic_zh: 發生火災時，請使用最近的出口。

en: a metal tool that sprays chemicals to put out fires
simple: The extinguisher is by the door.
toeic: Each extinguisher must be checked once a year by a licensed inspector.
toeic_zh: 每個滅火器都必須由合格檢查員每年檢查一次。

en: weakness or failure of a material under repeated stress
simple_zh: 材料疲勞影響橋樑安全。
toeic: Metal fatigue in structural supports requires preventive maintenance.
toeic_zh: 結構支撐中的金屬疲勞需要預防性維護。

en: a person whose job is to stop fires
toeic: A firefighter inspected the building before the grand opening.
toeic_zh: 開幕前，一位消防員檢查了這棟建築。

en: the state of being healthy and strong
simple: I go to the fitness center.
toeic: The company offers a free fitness program to all employees.
toeic_zh: 公司為所有員工提供免費健身計畫。

en: a common illness with fever and a sore throat
toeic: Many employees stayed home because of the flu.
toeic_zh: 許多員工因流感而待在家裡。

en: thick cloud close to the ground
simple: The fog was thick this morning.
toeic: Heavy fog delayed several flights this morning.
toeic_zh: 濃霧使今早數班航班延誤。

en: a building for keeping or repairing cars
simple: The car is in the garage.
toeic: Employees may park in the underground garage for free.
toeic_zh: 員工可免費停在地下停車場。

en: things that you throw away
toeic: Garbage is collected every Tuesday and Friday.
toeic_zh: 垃圾每週二和週五收集。

en: a person who works with plants in a garden
toeic: The hotel employs a full-time gardener to care for its grounds.
toeic_zh: 這間飯店聘請一位全職園丁照顧園區。

en: a machine that produces electricity
simple: The generator provides backup power during outages.
simple_zh: 發電機在停電期間提供備用電源。
toeic: Backup generators ensure continuous operations during power interruptions.
toeic_zh: 備用發電機確保電源中斷期間的持續運營。

en: something worn on the hand
toeic: Workers must wear a glove when handling chemicals.
toeic_zh: 工人處理化學品時必須戴手套。

en: a large room or building for sports and exercise
simple: The students play ball in the gymnasium.
toeic: The company rented the school gymnasium for its annual sports day.
toeic_zh: 公司租用學校體育館舉辦年度運動日。

en: a long narrow space inside a building with doors
toeic: Please keep the hallway clear in case of an emergency.
toeic_zh: 請保持走廊暢通，以防緊急狀況。

en: causing damage or injury
toeic: The chemicals used in this process may be harmful to workers.
toeic_zh: 此製程使用的化學品可能對工人有害。

en: good for your health
simple: A healthful meal has many vegetables.
simple_zh: 有益健康的餐點含有很多蔬菜。
toeic: The cafeteria now offers more healthful choices for employees.
toeic_zh: 員工餐廳現在提供更多有益健康的選擇。

en: a machine that makes a room or water warm
toeic: The technician will repair the broken heater in the lobby tomorrow.
toeic_zh: 技術人員明天會修理大廳壞掉的暖氣機。

en: a hard hat that protects your head
simple: He wears a helmet on his bike.
simple_zh: 他騎腳踏車時戴安全帽。
toeic: All visitors must wear a helmet inside the construction area.
toeic_zh: 所有訪客在施工區內都必須戴安全帽。

en: a person who owns a house
toeic: Each homeowner must pay property tax by the end of June.
toeic_zh: 每位屋主必須在六月底前繳納房屋稅。

en: a very strong storm with high winds
toeic: The hurricane forced the airline to cancel all flights to Miami.
toeic_zh: 颶風迫使航空公司取消所有飛往邁阿密的班機。

en: keeping clean to stay healthy
simple_zh: 良好的衛生習慣讓我們保持健康。
toeic: Restaurant staff must follow strict hygiene rules at all times.
toeic_zh: 餐廳員工必須隨時遵守嚴格的衛生規定。

en: Old things that have little value
simple: There is junk in the garage.
toeic: Please remove the junk from the storage room by Friday.
toeic_zh: 請在週五前清除儲藏室的雜物。

en: A tool with steps used to climb up
simple: He used a ladder to fix the roof.
toeic: Workers must use a ladder when changing the ceiling lights.
toeic_zh: 工人更換天花板燈具時必須使用梯子。

en: A device that gives light
simple: The lamp on my desk is bright.
toeic: The hotel room includes a reading lamp beside the bed.
toeic_zh: 旅館房間在床邊附有一盞閱讀燈。

en: a person who owns a building and rents it to others
toeic: The landlord agreed to repaint the office before we moved in.
toeic_zh: 房東同意在我們搬進來之前重新粉刷辦公室。
family: landlady (n) 女房東; landlord and tenant 房東與房客

en: An area of short grass
simple: The children are playing on the lawn.
toeic: A worker will cut the lawn every two weeks.
toeic_zh: 工人每兩週會修剪一次草坪。

en: the way something is arranged or organized
toeic: Strategic layout design optimizes workflow and operational efficiency.
toeic_zh: 戰略佈局設計優化了工作流程和運營效率。

en: a legal agreement to rent a building or land for a period of time
toeic: The company signed a three-year lease for the new office space.
toeic_zh: 公司簽下了新辦公空間的三年租約。
family: lease (v) 租賃; lessee 承租人; lessor 出租人; renew a lease 續約

en: a large open area just inside the entrance of a building
toeic: Visitors must sign in at the front desk in the lobby.
toeic_zh: 訪客必須在大廳的櫃檯登記。
family: hotel lobby 飯店大廳; lobby (v) 遊說; lobbyist (n) 說客

en: A small cupboard with a lock
simple: I put my bag in the locker.
toeic: Each employee has a locker in the changing room.
toeic_zh: 每位員工在更衣室都有一個置物櫃。

en: A cover worn over the face
simple: He wore a mask at the clinic.
toeic: Workers must wear a mask in the production area.
toeic_zh: 工人在生產區必須戴口罩。

en: Not strong or severe
toeic: The region enjoys a mild climate all year round.
toeic_zh: 這個地區全年氣候溫和。

en: A small flying insect that bites
simple: A mosquito bit me last night.
toeic: Guests should use mosquito spray when walking near the lake.
toeic_zh: 住客在湖邊散步時應使用防蚊噴劑。

en: A machine that cuts grass
simple: Dad uses the mower on Sunday.
toeic: The maintenance team bought a new mower for the park.
toeic_zh: 維修團隊為公園買了一台新割草機。

en: A thin metal pin hit into wood, or the hard part of a finger
simple: He used a nail to hang the picture.
toeic: Please store the nail boxes on the lower shelf.
toeic_zh: 請把釘子盒放在下層架上。

en: Food and its effect on health
simple_zh: 良好的營養讓我們健康。
toeic: The cafeteria menu was designed by a nutrition expert.
toeic_zh: 自助餐廳的菜單由營養專家設計。

en: Something that happens
simple: Rain is a daily occurrence here.
toeic: Report any unusual occurrence to the security office.
toeic_zh: 任何不尋常的事件都請向安全辦公室報告。

en: a socket for inserting an electrical plug
simple: I need an outlet to charge my phone.
simple_zh: 我需要一個插座來給手機充電。
toeic: Multiple outlets are conveniently located throughout the office for employee use.
toeic_zh: 整個辦公室中都方便地放置了多個插座供員工使用。

en: a person who paints walls or pictures
simple: The painter is on the ladder.
toeic: We hired a painter to repaint the lobby this weekend.
toeic_zh: 我們僱了一位油漆工本週末重新粉刷大廳。

en: a person walking, not driving
toeic: The new bridge was built for pedestrians and cyclists.
toeic_zh: 這座新橋是為行人與自行車騎士興建的。

en: a shop where medicine is sold
toeic: The pharmacy on Main Street opens at eight in the morning.
toeic_zh: 大街上的藥局早上八點開門。

en: a small piece of medicine
toeic: The doctor told him to take the pill after each meal.
toeic_zh: 醫師要他每餐飯後服用這顆藥。

en: to turn soil or clear snow
simple: The farmer will plow the field.
toeic: Crews plow the roads early after heavy snow.
toeic_zh: 大雪後工作人員會一早剷除道路積雪。

en: a person who fixes water pipes
toeic: The plumber arrived at noon to fix the leaking pipe.
toeic_zh: 水管工中午抵達修理漏水的管線。

en: a long thin piece of wood or metal
simple: The flag is on a pole.
toeic: Workers installed a new light pole near the entrance.
toeic_zh: 工人在入口附近裝設了一根新的燈柱。

en: to make air, water or land dirty
toeic: Factories that pollute the river will be fined heavily.
toeic_zh: 污染河川的工廠將被重罰。

en: to not allow by rule or law
toeic: Company rules prohibit employees from sharing passwords.
toeic_zh: 公司規定禁止員工分享密碼。

en: giving safety from harm
toeic: Workers must wear protective gear on the factory floor.
toeic_zh: 工廠現場的工人必須穿戴防護裝備。

en: the amount of rain that falls
toeic: Heavy rainfall caused delays at the construction site.
toeic_zh: 豪雨造成工地延誤。

en: with a lot of rain
simple: It is a rainy day today.
toeic: The outdoor concert was cancelled because of the rainy weather.
toeic_zh: 由於下雨的天氣，戶外音樂會被取消了。

en: a narrow line of light or energy
simple: A ray of sun came in.
toeic: Please wear sunscreen to protect your skin from harmful rays.
toeic_zh: 請擦防曬乳以保護皮膚免受有害光線傷害。

en: a person who sells houses and buildings
simple: The realtor showed us a house.
simple_zh: 房地產經紀人帶我們看了一間房子。
toeic: The realtor will arrange a viewing of the office space on Friday.
toeic_zh: 房地產經紀人將在週五安排辦公空間的看屋。

en: to treat used things so they can be used again
toeic: All employees are encouraged to recycle paper and plastic bottles.
toeic_zh: 鼓勵所有員工回收紙張和塑膠瓶。

en: to change how a room looks with paint or furniture
toeic: The hotel will close for a month to redecorate the lobby.
toeic_zh: 飯店將休館一個月以重新裝潢大廳。

en: a machine that keeps food cold
simple: The milk is in the refrigerator.
toeic: Please store all perishable food in the refrigerator.
toeic_zh: 請將所有易腐壞的食物存放在冰箱中。

en: to make pain or worry less
toeic: Hiring more staff will relieve the pressure on our team.
toeic_zh: 增聘人手將減輕我們團隊的壓力。

en: to change the structure or look of a building
simple: They want to remodel the house.
toeic: The bank plans to remodel its main branch next spring.
toeic_zh: 銀行計畫明年春天整修總行。

en: to repair and improve an old building
toeic: The hotel will renovate all of its guest rooms this winter.
toeic_zh: 這間飯店今年冬天將翻新所有客房。

en: the process of restoring something to good condition
toeic: The office underwent a complete renovation to improve employee comfort.
toeic_zh: 辦公室進行了全面翻新以改善員工舒適度。

en: a person who pays to use a house or car
toeic: Each renter must show a valid driver's license.
toeic_zh: 每位承租人都必須出示有效駕照。

en: to open again after being closed
simple_zh: 這家店很快會重新開門。
toeic: The museum will reopen next month after the repairs.
toeic_zh: 博物館將在整修後於下個月重新開放。

en: a person whose job is to fix things
toeic: A repairperson will visit your office tomorrow morning.
toeic_zh: 維修人員明天早上會到您的辦公室。

en: designed for living in or relating to where people live
toeic: Residential facilities must meet specific safety and comfort standards.
toeic_zh: 住宅設施必須符合特定的安全和舒適標準。

en: a public room with a toilet and sink
toeic: The restroom on the second floor is closed for cleaning.
toeic_zh: 二樓的洗手間因清潔而關閉。

en: in a way that avoids danger
toeic: Workers must handle the chemicals safely at all times.
toeic_zh: 員工必須隨時安全地處理化學品。

en: an underground pipe that carries waste water
simple: The sewer is under the street.
toeic: The city will repair the old sewer system next year.
toeic_zh: 市政府明年將修復老舊的下水道系統。

en: a path for walking beside a road
toeic: The city is repairing the sidewalk in front of the library.
toeic_zh: 市政府正在修繕圖書館前的人行道。

en: feeling that you want to sleep
toeic: Do not drive if you feel sleepy after taking this medicine.
toeic_zh: 服用此藥後若感到想睡，請勿開車。

en: having a lot of snow
toeic: Flights were delayed because of the snowy weather.
toeic_zh: 因為下雪的天氣，班機延誤了。

en: a product you use with water to wash
simple: Please wash your hands with soap.
toeic: The hotel provides free soap and shampoo.
toeic_zh: 這間飯店提供免費的肥皂和洗髮精。

en: a long soft seat for several people
simple: The cat is on the sofa.
toeic: The lobby has a leather sofa for waiting guests.
toeic_zh: 大廳有一張皮沙發供等候的客人使用。

en: having a lot of room inside
simple: The kitchen is bright and spacious.
toeic: Our new meeting room is spacious enough for fifty people.
toeic_zh: 我們的新會議室寬敞得足以容納五十人。
family: space (n) 空間; spaciously (adv); spacious office 寬敞的辦公室

en: to let liquid fall out by accident
toeic: Please clean up any coffee that you spill in the break room.
toeic_zh: 請清理您在休息室灑出的任何咖啡。

en: in a way that must be followed exactly
toeic: Visitors are strictly prohibited from entering the laboratory.
toeic_zh: 訪客嚴格禁止進入實驗室。

en: an area at the edge of a city
simple: We live in a quiet suburb.
toeic: The company moved its headquarters to a suburb of Chicago.
toeic_zh: 公司將總部搬到芝加哥的郊區。

en: bright with light from the sun
toeic: The forecast says it will be sunny all weekend.
toeic_zh: 預報說整個週末都會是晴天。

en: a cream that protects skin from the sun
toeic: Guests should apply sunscreen before going to the beach.
toeic_zh: 客人在去海灘前應塗抹防曬乳。

en: light from the sun
toeic: The resort enjoys sunshine almost all year round.
toeic_zh: 這間度假村幾乎全年都有陽光。

en: a person who pays rent to use a room or building
simple: The tenant pays rent every month.
toeic: Each tenant must report any damage to the building manager.
toeic_zh: 每位承租人都必須向大樓管理員通報任何損壞。
family: tenancy (n) 租期; commercial tenant 商業租戶; tenant and landlord 房客與房東

en: the crime of stealing
toeic: The store installed cameras to prevent theft.
toeic_zh: 這家店裝設攝影機以防竊盜。

en: a storm with thunder and lightning
toeic: The outdoor event was canceled because of a thunderstorm.
toeic_zh: 戶外活動因雷雨而取消。

en: a thin rectangular piece used to cover floors or walls
toeic: Marble tiles were selected for the lobby to create an elegant appearance.
toeic_zh: 為大廳選擇了大理石瓷磚以創造優雅的外觀。

en: things that you throw away
toeic: Please put all trash in the bins outside the building.
toeic_zh: 請將所有垃圾丟入大樓外的垃圾桶。

en: a long passage built under the ground or a mountain
simple: The train goes through a tunnel.
toeic: The new tunnel will cut the commute between the two cities by half.
toeic_zh: 新隧道將使兩城之間的通勤時間減半。

en: A folding cover that keeps rain off you.
simple: Take an umbrella. It is raining.
toeic: Please leave your umbrella in the stand by the entrance.
toeic_zh: 請把雨傘放在入口旁的傘架上。

en: Below the surface of the ground.
simple: We park in the underground garage.
simple_zh: 我們把車停在地下停車場。
toeic: The underground parking lot will be closed for repairs next week.
toeic_zh: 地下停車場下週將關閉維修。

en: Already started and now in progress.
toeic: Construction of the new office building is already underway.
toeic_zh: 新辦公大樓的興建工程已經展開。

en: In a way that is not normal.
toeic: The store was unusually busy during the holiday weekend.
toeic_zh: 假日週末期間這家店異常忙碌。

en: On or to a higher floor of a building.
toeic: The accounting department is located upstairs on the third floor.
toeic_zh: 會計部門位於樓上三樓。

en: A basic service such as water or electricity.
simple_zh: 水電費帳單今天寄到了。
toeic: Rent includes all utility costs such as water and gas.
toeic_zh: 租金包含水和瓦斯等所有公用事業費用。

en: empty and not being used
toeic: There are two vacant offices on the fifth floor.
toeic_zh: 五樓有兩間空辦公室。
family: vacancy (n) 空缺；空房; vacate (v) 騰出; a vacant position 職缺

en: To leave a place so others can use it.
simple: Guests must vacate the room by noon.
simple_zh: 房客必須在中午前退房。
toeic: Tenants are required to vacate the premises by the end of May.
toeic_zh: 房客須在五月底前搬離該場所。

en: A machine that cleans floors by sucking up dirt.
simple: She uses a vacuum every day.
toeic: Our new vacuum cleaner is lighter and quieter than the old model.
toeic_zh: 我們的新吸塵器比舊款更輕更安靜。

en: To break a rule or law.
toeic: Any employee who violates the safety policy will be warned.
toeic_zh: 違反安全政策的員工將受到警告。

en: An act of breaking a rule or law.
toeic: The company paid a fine for a safety violation.
toeic_zh: 公司因違反安全規定而繳納罰款。

en: A natural substance the body needs to stay healthy.
simple: Oranges have a lot of vitamin C.
toeic: The company sells vitamin supplements through its online store.
toeic_zh: 該公司透過網路商店銷售維他命補充品。

en: A path for people to walk on.
toeic: A covered walkway connects the parking lot to the main lobby.
toeic_zh: 有頂的走道連接停車場與主要大廳。

en: A room or section in a hospital.
simple: She is in the children's ward.
toeic: Visitors may enter the ward only between two and five p.m.
toeic_zh: 訪客只能在下午兩點至五點間進入病房。

en: A chair with wheels for people who cannot walk.
toeic: The hotel provides a wheelchair for guests who need one.
toeic_zh: 飯店為有需要的房客提供輪椅。

en: Wild animals living in nature.
simple_zh: 我們喜歡觀察野生動物。
toeic: The park works to protect local wildlife and plants.
toeic_zh: 這座公園致力於保護當地野生動物與植物。

en: With a lot of wind.
toeic: Because it was windy, the outdoor event was moved inside.
toeic_zh: 因為風大，戶外活動改到室內舉行。

en: a long piece of steel or other material used as a main structural support
toeic: Load-bearing beams distribute weight throughout the structure.
toeic_zh: 承重梁在整個結構中分配重量。

en: a small rectangular block used in building
simple: The wall is made of red brick.
toeic: Premium bricks were imported from Europe to match the architectural design.
toeic_zh: 高級磚從歐洲進口以匹配建築設計。

en: the organization and coordination of activities or operations
simple_zh: 團隊之間的協調至關重要。
toeic: Effective coordination ensures smooth project implementation.
toeic_zh: 有效的協調確保順利的項目實施。

en: intended to fix or remedy a problem
toeic: Corrective maintenance addresses identified problems and failures.
toeic_zh: 糾正性維護解決已識別的問題和故障。

en: a state of balance between opposing forces
toeic: Force equilibrium analysis determines structural safety factors.
toeic_zh: 力平衡分析確定結構安全因子。

en: relating to a city or town government
toeic: Municipal building codes establish minimum construction and safety standards.
toeic_zh: 市政建築法規制定了最低建築和安全標準。

en: responsible management or an unintentional mistake
simple: Oversight is critical for project success.
simple_zh: 監督對項目成功至關重要。
toeic: Project oversight ensures adherence to timelines and budgets.
toeic_zh: 項目監督確保遵守時間表和預算。

en: a thin wall that divides a room into parts
toeic: We installed a glass partition to create a quiet meeting area.
toeic_zh: 我們裝設了玻璃隔間，打造出安靜的會議區。

en: occurring or recurring at intervals
simple_zh: 定期測試確保系統可靠性。
toeic: Periodic maintenance programs optimize long-term facility performance.
toeic_zh: 定期維護計劃優化長期設施性能。

en: the action of watching and directing someone or something
toeic: Professional supervision ensures construction quality and safety compliance.
toeic_zh: 專業監督確保施工質量和安全合規。

en: decorative or protective strips along edges or joints
toeic: Finish trim selection significantly impacts architectural aesthetics.
toeic_zh: 飾邊選擇顯著影響建築美學。

en: The act of making people obey a rule.
simple: The enforcement of the law is strict.
simple_zh: 這項法律執行得很嚴格。
toeic: Stricter enforcement of safety rules reduced workplace accidents.
toeic_zh: 更嚴格地執行安全規定減少了職場意外。

en: Careful protection of nature or resources.
toeic: The plant started an energy conservation program to cut costs.
toeic_zh: 工廠推出節能計畫以降低成本。

en: A sudden strong explosion or rush of air.
toeic: A gas blast damaged part of the factory last night.
toeic_zh: 昨晚一場瓦斯爆炸損毀了工廠的一部分。

en: A treatment that makes a sick person well.
simple: There is no cure for the cold.
toeic: The firm is investing in research to find a cure for the disease.
toeic_zh: 這家公司投資研究以尋找這種疾病的療法。

en: Causing physical or emotional pain.
toeic: Closing the factory was a painful decision for management.
toeic_zh: 關閉工廠對管理階層而言是痛苦的決定。

en: in a way related to the body
toeic: Employees must be physically present to sign the contract.
toeic_zh: 員工必須親自到場簽署合約。

en: something that protects from harm
simple: The soldier held a big shield.
toeic: A protective shield covers the machine's moving parts.
toeic_zh: 防護罩覆蓋著機器的活動零件。

en: the act of stopping something bad
toeic: Accident prevention training is required for all factory staff.
toeic_zh: 所有工廠員工都必須接受事故預防訓練。

en: a large hole in the ground
toeic: The mining company opened a new pit last spring.
toeic_zh: 這家礦業公司去年春天開了一座新礦坑。

en: relating to official rules and control
simple: A regulatory agency checks the rules.
toeic: The product must pass a regulatory review before sale.
toeic_zh: 該產品在銷售前必須通過法規審查。

en: a sudden loud burst, or a rapid increase
simple_zh: 我們聽到一聲巨大的爆炸聲。
toeic: There has been an explosion in demand for smartphones.
toeic_zh: 智慧型手機的需求出現了激增。

en: very unpleasant
toeic: The nasty storm delayed all of our flights.
toeic_zh: 惡劣的暴風雨使我們所有航班都延誤了。

en: able to continue without harming the environment
toeic: The firm is committed to sustainable business practices.
toeic_zh: 公司致力於永續的經營方式。

en: protected from a disease or effect
simple: Vaccines make you immune to disease.
toeic: No business is immune to economic downturns.
toeic_zh: 沒有任何企業能不受經濟衰退影響。

en: a person who works for social or political change
simple: The activist spoke to the crowd.
simple_zh: 這位活動人士對群眾演說。
toeic: Environmental activists protested outside the factory.
toeic_zh: 環保人士在工廠外抗議。

en: a firm hold on something
simple: Keep a good grip on the bag.
toeic: The new tires give the truck a better grip on wet roads.
toeic_zh: 新輪胎讓卡車在濕滑路面上有更好的抓地力。

en: in a very bad or serious way
simple: The storm severely damaged the roof.
simple_zh: 暴風雨嚴重損壞了屋頂。
toeic: The factory was severely affected by the power outage.
toeic_zh: 工廠受到停電的嚴重影響。

en: to throw away or drop something carelessly
toeic: It is illegal to dump waste into the river.
toeic_zh: 把廢棄物傾倒入河中是違法的。

en: a substance that can harm or kill
toeic: The label warns that the cleaner is a poison if swallowed.
toeic_zh: 標籤警告這種清潔劑若吞食會有毒。

en: of a province or region outside the capital
simple: It is a quiet provincial town.
simple_zh: 這是個安靜的地方小鎮。
toeic: The provincial government approved the new factory plan.
toeic_zh: 省政府批准了新工廠的計畫。

en: a pipe that carries water away; something that uses up resources
toeic: The old equipment is a drain on our budget.
toeic_zh: 這些老舊設備消耗了我們的預算。

en: the line where sky meets land; future outlook
simple: The sun sank below the horizon.
toeic: New opportunities are on the horizon for our company.
toeic_zh: 我們公司即將迎來新的機會。

en: the length of time or distance something covers
simple: The bridge has a long span.
toeic: The contract covers a span of three years.
toeic_zh: 這份合約涵蓋三年的期間。

en: the state of being alone or apart from others
simple: He lived in isolation for a year.
toeic: Patients with the virus were kept in isolation.
toeic_zh: 感染病毒的病患被隔離。

en: a medicine that protects the body from a disease
simple: I got a flu vaccine today.
toeic: The pharmaceutical company is developing a new vaccine.
toeic_zh: 那家製藥公司正在研發新疫苗。

en: the act of putting medicine or money into something
simple: The nurse gave me an injection.
toeic: The project needs an injection of funds to stay on schedule.
toeic_zh: 這個專案需要資金挹注才能如期進行。

en: the sudden start of something bad, like a disease or war
simple: There was an outbreak of flu here.
toeic: The outbreak of the virus forced the factory to close temporarily.
toeic_zh: 病毒爆發迫使工廠暫時關閉。

en: likely to explode or increase very fast
toeic: The company saw explosive growth in online sales last year.
toeic_zh: 該公司去年的網路銷售出現爆發性成長。

en: an official order or authority to do something
simple: The mayor has a clear mandate.
toeic: The new safety mandate requires all workers to wear helmets.
toeic_zh: 新的安全規定要求所有工人配戴安全帽。

en: the act of building something again
simple: The reconstruction of the bridge took a year.
simple_zh: 這座橋的重建花了一年。
toeic: Reconstruction of the damaged warehouse will begin next month.
toeic_zh: 受損倉庫的重建工程將於下個月開始。

en: likely to suffer from something
simple: This area is prone to floods.
toeic: Older machines are prone to breaking down.
toeic_zh: 較舊的機器容易故障。

en: able to be replaced or used again naturally
simple_zh: 風能是一種可再生能源。
toeic: The company plans to invest in renewable energy sources.
toeic_zh: 該公司計畫投資再生能源。

en: to build something again
toeic: The city plans to rebuild the bridge damaged by the storm.
toeic_zh: 市府計畫重建被風暴損毀的橋。

en: Relating to the government
toeic: Governmental approval is required before construction begins.
toeic_zh: 動工前需要政府核准。

en: A written law passed by a government
toeic: Under the statute, companies must report all accidents.
toeic_zh: 依據該法規，公司必須通報所有事故。

en: To run away from danger
toeic: Residents were told to flee the area before the storm hit.
toeic_zh: 居民被告知要在暴風雨來襲前撤離該地區。

en: To burst loudly, or increase suddenly
toeic: Online sales began to explode during the holiday season.
toeic_zh: 假期期間網路銷售開始暴增。

en: A glass building for growing plants
toeic: The greenhouse gas emissions of the plant must be reduced.
toeic_zh: 工廠的溫室氣體排放量必須減少。
